name: Teman
overview: The name Teman first appears in Scripture as a son of Eliphaz, the eldest son of Esau, establishing Teman as a significant figure among the Edomite chiefs. The descendants of Teman, often called Temani or Temanites, formed a notable people group within Edom, as indicated by the recurring mention of dukes bearing the name Teman in genealogical records. The land of Teman is also referenced as a region ruled by leaders such as Husham, highlighting its distinct identity among Edomite territories. These passages collectively affirm Teman's role both as an individual ancestor and as the namesake of a people and place within the biblical narrative.
